title: Duplex in Decatur
kidsText: Two homes you rent out. The bank lends most of the money. Rent pays you each month.
adultText: Two units on a quiet street, both rented to long-term tenants. The bank will carry most of it.

title: Starter Condo
kidsText: A small home near a hospital. Nurses rent it, so it is almost never empty.
adultText: One bedroom near the hospital. Nurses rent it on rotating contracts, so it is rarely empty.

title: Lawn Care Trailer
kidsText: Mowers, a trailer, and eight yards to cut each week. A helper does the work.
adultText: A used trailer, two mowers, and a list of eight weekly customers. You hire a high-schooler to run it.

title: Total Market Index Fund
kidsText: A tiny piece of many companies. It grows a little every month.
adultText: A slice of every big company at once. Slow and boring, it grows a little every month and pays out a sliver of its value.

title: Birchwood Robotics Shares
kidsText: A new robot company. Its price jumps around a lot. Buy low if you can.
adultText: A young company that builds warehouse robots. The price swings; buy low if you can.

title: Vending Machine Route
kidsText: Six snack machines. Fill them on Saturdays and keep the coins.
adultText: Six snack machines in office lobbies. You restock them on Saturdays and keep the coins.

title: Lakeshore Utilities Shares
kidsText: The power company. Nobody gets rich on it, but it pays you a little every month.
adultText: The power company. Nobody gets rich on it, but it pays a dividend every month like clockwork.

title: High-Yield Savings Account
kidsText: A safe place for your money. It grows a tiny bit every month.
adultText: Online bank, no fees, insured. It will never make you rich, but it grows every month and it is there when the furnace dies.
